name: localstack-demo
description: LocalStack colloquium demo – notes app with S3, Lambda & API Gateway

scripts.test: python3 -m venv .venv-tests && ./.venv-tests/bin/python -m pip install -q -r lambda/requirements.txt && ./.venv-tests/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests/integration -p "test_notes_handler.py"
scripts.clean: docker compose down -v && rm -rf .venv-tests lambda/build lambda/function.zip lambda/node_modules volume terraform/.terraform terraform/*.tfstate*
